kfxlib is an unmodified copy of `python/kfxlib/*.py` from:
https://github.com/kaikozlov/kindle.koplugin/tree/5ed7485338c331e6502ac33dba1cb026dd7cc2a2/python/kfxlib

Originally KFX Input by John Howell, copyright 2016–2026, GPL v3.
See file headers and LICENSE-GPL-3.txt. Upstream plugin's MIT license does
not replace kfxlib's GPL license. Keep these notices when redistributing.

The builder imports the parser directly; it does not require Calibre or
KOReader. Dependencies are pinned in the project root requirements.txt.
